# Airbotix

> K-12 AI coding and robotics education. Teaching the next generation to code with AI.

We run AI + robotics workshops in Australian schools, then continue learning on our online platform. **Workshops drive platform signups → platform produces hackathon-ready students → hackathon outcomes drive new workshops.**

## Our stack

- 🤖 **Layer 1 — Curriculum & Workshops** (live) · In-school AI + robotics workshops · 100+ students · 2 partner schools
- 💻 **Layer 2 — Platform** (building) · Kids-safe AI coding environment + parent dashboard · powered by [Kids in AI](https://github.com/kidsinai)
- 🏆 **Layer 3 — Hackathons** (year 2) · Quarterly competitions for 12+ students

## Related organisations

- **[Kids in AI](https://github.com/kidsinai)** — mission brand for our Layer-2 product (open-source curriculum + tools)
- **[Kids Make AI](https://github.com/kidsmakeai)** — event/campaign brand for hackathons + workshops
- **[DeepRouter](https://github.com/deeprouter-ai)** — LLM gateway powering AI features
